out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Reports being "transported" from the Queensboro station platform into a WTC tower stairwell, moving down stairs with others, then "immediately transported back" to the platform.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Describes feeling "split into two," being in a dark stairwell with screaming people, panic, stairwell buckling "like a vacuum," and "free-fall" with many hands grabbing her while falling.

arrival.other_being_detail: Speculates her body was "being held up by other entities (Angels, Higher Self or Guardians)" upon return to the platform, but does not describe seeing them.

environment.environment_other_detail: Post-event at home, she reports her apartment contained "three souls/spirits/individuals" from the WTC, each occupying consistent locations (sofa, bedroom, kitchen) and causing physical sounds (pots and pans).

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Felt compelled to help three confused deceased souls from the WTC "go to the Light"; later volunteered to support responders and followed prayer instructions for the souls' release.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Not a medical near-death crisis is described; experience occurred while witnessing the 9/11 WTC attacks from a subway platform and includes a claimed sudden "transport" into a tower and back.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: States she was in the second year of reading and practicing 'A Course in Miracles' and references God, angels/guardians, and "the Light."
person_demographics.occupation: Case manager at a non-profit organization

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Post-event: perceived visitation/presence of three deceased WTC souls in her apartment for several nights; later performed a candle/prayer ceremony to help them "go to the Light."
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No typical NDE sequence (no tunnel/light/life review/boundary). Instead: witnessing 9/11 → sudden claimed transport into tower stairwell/free-fall → instant return to platform → later multi-night spirit-presence in apartment → prayer/candle ritual leading to their departure.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Describes feeling "split into two" and suggests she may have been in two places at once (tower and platform).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience is framed as a "quantum leap/jump" or multidimensional collision while not near death medically; includes claimed bilocation/splitting and later multi-night presence of three WTC souls in her apartment with physical disturbances, followed by a guided candle/prayer release ritual.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "it felt like I was split into two"; "I was transported to one of the towers"; "We all started to free-fall"; "I never hit the bottom because I was immediately transported back"; "I immediately knew they were from the WTC center"; "I promise I will find a way to help each one of you go to the Light".
